'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Leo Molitor DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Leo Molitor]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
